# Slate Cinema

> Slate Cinema is a Brooklyn, NY-based video production and marketing studio. From concept to campaign, we create cinematic content built to capture attention, tell stories, and drive engagement — for brands across AI, athletics, travel, real estate, healthcare, products, corporate, organizations, and education.

Slate Cinema handles the full production pipeline in-house: pre-production (scripts, storyboards, casting, scheduling), production (on-set filming with full crew), post-production (editing, color, sound design, motion graphics, VFX, AI-assisted workflows), and distribution (platform-native cuts, ad management, social strategy).

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://slatecinema.com/): Overview, reel, results, and client trust signals.
- [How It Works](https://slatecinema.com/how-it-works): The four-phase production pipeline explained — pre-production, production, post-production, distribution.
- [Portfolio](https://slatecinema.com/portfolio): Case studies and work samples across all industries served.
- [Contact / Get Started](https://slatecinema.com/contact): Start a project — quick lead form, full project intake, or schedule a call.
- [Schedule a Call](https://slatecinema.com/schedule-a-call): Book a 20-minute call directly with the team.
- [Journal](https://slatecinema.com/journal): Articles on video marketing, storytelling, and content strategy.

## Industries Served

AI, Athletics, Travel, Real Estate, Healthcare, Products, Corporate, Organizations, Education — each with a dedicated portfolio page at `/portfolio/{industry-slug}`.
